Text:
# YERSINIA ENTEROCOLITICA

Antimicrobials are indicated only for patients with severe disease or immune compromise.

## _______________________________________________________________________________

References:
Sanford Guide article: Gastroenteritis, Y. enterocolitica
DOI: 10.1093/cid/cix669-Shane et al, Clinical Infectious Diseases 2017, 65(12):45-80
Up-to-Date article: Yersiniosis: Infection due to Yersinia enterocolitica and Yersinia pseudotuberculosis
Therapy:
## Primary treatment of gastroenteritis

Hydration and electrolyte replacement

## Antimicrobial treatment of severe gastroenteritis or immunocompromised patient

## Inpatient

Preferred:
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 5 days [R,DI]

Alternative:
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet q12h for 5 days [R,DI]

## Outpatient

Preferred:
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 5 days [R,DI]
Non-VA order for above

Alternative:
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet q12h for 5 days [R,DI]
Non-VA order for above
